idea-plugin.name: Actions EOL Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Node 20 is removed from GitHub-hosted runners on 2026-09-23 and ubuntu-22.04 deprecation opens 2026-09-17. This checks a workflow file against 25 dated GitHub shutdowns and names the date each line stops running.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Actions EOL Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 25 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/actions-deprecation-lint-2026 (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/actions-deprecation-lint-2026

action.text: Actions EOL Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run Actions EOL Lint on the file in the editor
